title: Lola Basyang-like? Palace slams Sara Duterte over 'no-el' claims
summary: Malacañang on Thursday likened Vice President Sara Duterte to the fictional fairy tale storyteller Lola Basyang, following claims from her camp of alleged plans to halt the 2028 national elections.

blocks.text: Malacañang on Thursday likened Vice President Sara Duterte to the fictional fairy tale storyteller Lola Basyang, following claims from her camp of alleged plans to halt the 2028 national elections.
Palace Press Officer Undersecretary Claire Castro said Duterte's camp should stop spinning tales, emphasizing that President Ferdinand Marcos "Bongbong" Marcos Jr. is busy working for the country.

"Busy ang Pangulo sa pagtatrabaho. Sunod-sunod ang dinadaluhang meeting ni Pangulong Marcos, Jr. kaya okupado ang isip niya, hindi tulad ng iba na walang ginagawa kundi maglakwatsa," the Palace Press Officer said in a statement.
(The President is busy working. President Marcos Jr. has been attending meeting after meeting. His mind has been occupied, unlike others who do nothing but wander around.)
"Huwag silang magkwento ng gawa-gawa lang nila. Sa ngayon, para nang 'Lola Basyang' si VP Sara sa kanilang mga kwentong pantasya," she added.
(They should stop tales they simply made up. Right now, with all these fantasy tales, VP Sara is starting to sound like 'Lola Basyang.')
Castro said Duterte's camp should instead talk about the alleged hidden wealth of the Vice President and her family—one of key issues in her ongoing impeachment trial.
In a television interview, Atty. Paolo Panelo Jr, the vice president's spokesperson, said Duterte told him she received information that there alleged plans of "no-el" or no elections in 2028.
Panelo said talks about such supposed plans come from the House of Representatives. — VDV, GMA News
